name: m5-249-ab
description: Standalone A/B of [retronym/scala#249](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/249), *Build compound base type sequences without relying on escape analysis*, against its parent on upstream 2.13.x (`762d80f17e`). Neither build has the perf-integration changes or `-Dscalac.hashSeed`, and the JIT runs in its default mode, so this measures the change as it would land upstream, JIT timing lottery included.

Full compile of the `scala` corpus, single-shot, 8 warmup + 6 measured ops; patched JDK 26, 8G heap with a fixed 3G young generation; xctrace counts the benchmark threads' instructions. Builds alternate fork by fork over 10 rounds. In the `-Xbatch` seed study on the perf-integration build, the change cut allocation by 144 MB/op at every seed and instructions by a median 0.85% (to `pickler`), and removed a seed whose C2 compile of `compoundBaseTypeSeq` lost escape analysis.

variantDescriptions.pr: retronym/scala#249 (`95ec0f6805`): `compoundBaseTypeSeq` merges into a presized array in its own method, with no buffer, closures, iterators or extractors
